episodes.title: Le journal du matin, dimanche 18 octobre
episodes.headline_en: After the violence of 17 October, Emmanuel Macron will address the French at 8pm this evening, the Elysee announces
summary_en: After the violence of 17 October, Emmanuel Macron will address the French at 8pm this evening, the Elysee announces
Pope Leo XIV appears in public for the first time since his operation, at the Angelus in Saint Peter's Square
Before his address, the president will meet the Prime Minister and the ministers concerned at 5.30pm
